comment: Which action classes this instance may take alone, and which need a named human role first. The kernel already owns the profile ladder and the HUMAN_REQUIRED surface; this file is the instance's declaration of who that human is and for what. Copy and fill.

roles.description: Runs the instance. May pause, resume and read everything.

gates.description: Anything that leaves the instance: a pull request, an email, a filing, a device command.
Declaring a finding true or false. Never automatic; the kernel refuses a non-operator verdict.
Observing the corpus and writing observation-class ledgers.
